squirrel.services.chat.MessagingService

class squirrel.services.chat.MessagingService.MessagingService(db=None)[source]

Bases: object

Handle messaging operations for chat interactions.

Each public method is intentionally narrow: callers pass in the objects they already have; this service handles all SQL concerns.

Parameters:

db (Optional[PostgresService]) – An open PostgresService instance. When omitted a new one is created using environment-variable credentials.

save_chat_turn(request, response, file_urls)[source]

Persist a completed chat turn to the chat_messages table.

Parameters:

  • request (AgentRequest) – The original chat request from the user.

  • response (AgentResponse) – The assistant’s response.

  • file_urls (list[str]) – Resolved s3:// URLs for any files attached to the request (may be empty).

Returns:

True when the row was written successfully.

Return type:

bool

get_conversation_history(conversation_id, limit=50)[source]

Return recent messages for conversation_id, oldest first.

Parameters:

  • conversation_id (str) – The conversation to fetch.

  • limit (int) – Maximum number of rows to return.

Returns:

List of row dicts ordered by created_at ascending.

Return type:

list[dict]
